sentences.text: Shri Anil Kumar Namdeo - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Supriya Singh - Deputy Govt. Advocate for the State.

Order 
This is fourth application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nargik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 3.2.2023 in connection with Crime No. 20/2023, registered at Police Station Talaiya District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)
(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5(L)/6 and 17/17 of the POCSO Act and Section 67 of the I.T. Act.
Earlier application was considered on merits and was dismissed.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that it is not the case of rape but of consent.
Prosecutrix has crossed the age of 16 years.
Applicant is also young man of about 21 years of age.
Applicant is in jail since 3.2.2023.
Investigation is complete.
Considering the long period of incarceration and young age of applicant and the fact that he is no longer required for custodial investigation, he may be enlarged on bail.

3. Govt. Advocate for the State has opposed the prayer and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:46110 2 MCRC-31868-2024 submitted that prosecutrix is minor.
She had received injuries on her body which shows that act was not consensual.
Earlier application was dismissed on merits.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix is said to have raped inside the hotel.
It is not the prosecution case that she was abducted and taken there.
There is delay in FIR.
Applicant is aged about 21 years.
He is in jail for about last one year and there is no likelihood of completion of trial in near future.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

8. In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 480 (3)
of Bhartiya Nargik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
